title: Clerk feature card
description: A 16px-rounded feature tile: an illustration area plus a small 13px title and muted text, above or below it. White with a layered soft shadow on light themes; #212126 with a faint inner top highlight on dark ones.
notes: rows/cols spans apply from md up; put cards in a grid with fixed row heights (clerk-features does)
the card is a hover group: illustrations can animate with group-hover
name: clerk-card

props.name: visual
props.description: the illustration (see clerk-art); fills the space the text leaves

props.name: textFirst
props.description: text above the illustration instead of below it

props.name: rows
props.description: grid rows the card spans from md up

props.name: cols
props.description: grid columns the card spans from md up

props.name: visualClassName
props.description: min height of the illustration area on phones (Tailwind class), e.g. "min-h-56"
